profile_text.body:
Google is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. According to its website, Google describes Gemini as its AI assistant for help with writing, planning, brainstorming, and other tasks powered by generative AI. The company reported revenue of $402,836,000,000 for the year ending December 31, 2025.

Google's AI product portfolio spans multiple categories. It offers Gemini as a general LLM assistant, Google AI Studio for model prototyping, and NotebookLM for document grounding. In healthcare, Google provides Med-PaLM and MedLM, medical LLMs focused on clinical reasoning and healthcare data that require HIPAA BAA. Google's productivity tools include Google Drive AI, Google Meet AI for meeting summaries and live captions, and integration of Gemini across Google Workspace. The company also maintains TensorFlow and Keras, open source ML frameworks.

Google's AI infrastructure is accessible through multiple MCP servers covering Google Ads campaign management, Google Search Console, Google Calendar, Google Forms, Google News, Google Trends, and Google OAuth authentication services. The company faces 220 lawsuits in California. Google is a publicly traded company under ticker GOOGL with CIK 0001652044.
